Terms & Rules

Community Guidelines

Welcome to our platform! By registering, you agree to follow these rules:

1. Respect Others

  • Treat all members with respect and dignity
  • No harassment, bullying, or hate speech
  • No discrimination based on race, gender, religion, or nationality
  • Keep discussions civil and constructive

2. Prohibited Content

  • No NSFW or adult content
  • No violence or threats
  • No spam or excessive advertising
  • No sharing of personal information without consent
  • No illegal content or activities

3. Privacy & Security

  • Protect your account credentials
  • Do not share your password with others
  • Report any security concerns to administrators
  • Respect other users' privacy

4. Server Rules

  • Follow individual server rules and guidelines
  • Respect channel purposes and topics
  • Do not disrupt server activities
  • Listen to moderators and administrators

5. Consequences

Violations may result in:

  • Warning or temporary mute
  • Temporary or permanent ban
  • Account suspension or deletion

6. Your Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for your account activity
  • Report inappropriate behavior
  • Help maintain a positive community
  • Keep your information accurate and up-to-date
